The '''Upper Hollows''' was a cave system in the [[Tythos Ridge]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] range on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising|uprising]] of the native [[Flesh Raider]]s, the Hollows were used to store a cache of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weapons, but the [[Hero of Tython|Padawan of]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] recovered the weapons for the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims]] of [[Kalikori village]].
